title: Activation ribbon: modular onboarding checklist and contextual tips
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and hand off a compact, dismissible "activation ribbon" that surfaces the first-run checklist, contextual tips, and lightweight screenshots for the Console onboarding flow. Goal is to provide progressive discovery for new teams without blocking advanced users. Deliverables: Figma source file with annotated variants (light/dark/high-contrast), a set of optimized PNG/SVG screenshots for marketing/docs, microcopy variants for internationalization, Lottie/animated GIF sequences for the initial guide, and an engineering-ready spec with tokens and interaction timing. This ticket covers visual design, microcopy iterations, accessibility verification, and asset packaging for the April SDK release.
updates: 2025-02-06: Kickoff meeting with PM (Ethan Ross) and Eng lead (Harpreet Singh). Agreed scope: ribbon should support dismiss/restore, keyboard shortcut tip, and link to quickstart templates.
2025-02-09: Low-fidelity ribbon exploration sketches uploaded to Figma. Explored 'compact pill' vs 'full-width bar' layouts. Team favored compact pill for smaller viewports.
2025-02-11: Microcopy A/B drafted (goal-oriented vs. procedural tone). PM requested more explicit cost and latency callouts for Dedicated users — added conditional copy variants.

2025-02-13: Accessibility review stub by Security (Olivia Martinez): color contrast checks passed for light/dark, need focus-visible state for keyboard navigation and aria-live announcements for step changes.
2025-02-16: Design review with Eng: agreed on KV cache tip placement, deferred animated onboarding to follow-up sub-issue due to perf concerns. Engineering asked for static PNG sequence as fallback.
2025-02-18: Prepared final artboards for light/dark/high-contrast; exported initial set of optimized assets. Created GitHub PR template for asset handoff (PR #7381).
2025-02-20: PM review accepted the microcopy with small edit; blocked on ENG-4987 for analytics events to enable step completion tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with annotated variants (light/dark/high-contrast) exists and is linked in ticket.
Microcopy approved by PM and localization lead and provided as a simple CSV for i18n.
Exported art assets include: SVG icons, 1x/2x PNG screenshots for key flows, and one animated GIF fallback for the first step.
Accessibility checklist completed: focus states, aria attributes, keyboard flow, and screen reader announcements verified.
Design tokens and spacing guidelines documented in the handoff spec and added to the engineering PR.
QA checklist with test cases for dismissal/restore flows, keyboard shortcut, and analytics events has been attached.
Assets packaged and merged to design-assets repo; design sign-off recorded in PR comments.
main_components: Contextual tip popover (linked to route-level help)
design_specs: Height: 48px for pill; 16px horizontal padding; 8px icon spacing
Animation: fade-in 180ms ease, slide-up 160ms; animated GIF fallback max 2MB
Colors: use token --surface-1 / --text-primary for light; --surface-2 / --text-on-dark for dark; high-contrast variant uses --hc-bg / --hc-text
Type: Inter 14/16 semibold for CTA; body 13 regular for microcopy
Accessibility: focus-visible ring 3px, contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text, aria-live="polite" for step announcements
risks: Animated sequences could increase load; engineering requested a static fallback which adds implementation complexity.
Analytics event dependency (ENG-4987) blocking completion state tracking; without it, product can't surface 'completed onboarding' metrics.
Localization scope could expand if we need right-to-left variants; accounted as out-of-scope for this ticket but noted for follow-up.
mockup_paths: Figma Frame: Activation Ribbon / Variants / Compact-Pill
handoff_notes: Include CSS custom properties mapping to design tokens in PR description.
Provide two delivery bundles: static assets (SVG/PNG) and optional animated bundle (GIF/Lottie) with polyfill instructions.
Engineer should implement show/hide and local storage flag for restore; provide 'restore ribbon' affordance under Help menu.
Tag engineering PR with 'design-handoff' label and link this ticket.
qa_plan: Verify ribbon shows only for new orgs and on first user; test dismiss and restore flows.
Keyboard-only navigation: tab order to ribbon, open checklist modal, and close with Escape.
Screen reader: Confirm step announcements and that dismiss/restore announce status.
Performance: ensure initial page load time impact < 80ms for asset fetch on 4G simulated network.
notes: This ticket intentionally avoids a fully modal guided tour; we aim for a low-friction, progressive discovery pattern.
Follow-up tickets will cover enterprise variants (SAML onboarding hints) and A/B experiments for microcopy tone.
